about: Speaking to FERB from the phone keeps every word said until the owner lets go (kb PHN-603; FERB.app's APP-673 and APP-675, whose DictationTests these sequences come from). Both phones run them: Android's DictationTest and the iPhone's DictationTests. Steps: begin (a new recognition task; tasks are numbered from 0), heard (an answer of a task: text, final, ended = the recognizer marked the utterance's end, start and end in seconds), fail (a task ended with an error; noSpeech), leave (the current task stops being fed), finish (the owner let go). 'step' is what the capture says next: keep, restart (a new task on the same microphone), failed, or finished:<text>. 'text' checks everything said so far.
